text:
maria: quick async check — Optimize toolkit delivery status? need a short run-down on quant recommendations, batching/caching suggestions, and any open regression alerts. owners and next milestone?

kevin: I own quant recommendations. Current plan: promote q4_0 -> q4_8 for small-medium models, q8_0 for large. Targeting canary by Tue.

alex: PR is up for the batching changes (PR #432). waiting on one review from @kevin. main change: switch default dynamic batcher window to 20ms, max_batch=64.

kevin: reviewing now. can we include a toggle so Dedicated customers keep old behavior? don't want surprise perf delta.

alex: yes — added `batching.policy.override: true` in the PR, config example in the description.

sophia: heads up — regression alert from evals yesterday: quant q4_8 increases hallucination rate on the faq dataset by ~3.2% for seq_len>1024. I logged samples in S3 (s3://redwood-evals/optkit/regressions/1812/).

maria: ack. @kevin, can you validate q4_8 on long sequences and push a mitigation plan? we should avoid surprise customer churn.

kevin: will run cross-seq validation today. if we can't get satisfactory quality, fallback plan is auto-rollout with per-route quality gating (keep q4_0 for routes with quality drop).

ci-bot: build:batcher-tests #432 — all checks passed (3/3).

alex: thanks. Also need eng-platform to enable prefix-KV cache hooks — batching depends on cache invalidation policy. @jamie any ETA on cache API change?

jamie: eng-platform: we can expose a `cache.ttl_per_route` flag. ETA end of week if no blockers. will post the spec in #eng-platform.

maria: great. can we list explicit owners & milestones? I'm building the release checklist.

kevin: owner: quant profiles + validation = kevin. milestone1: cross-seq validation + decide fallback (Mon EOD). milestone2: canary rollout to 10% with metrics (Wed).

alex: owner: batching implementation + PRs = alex. milestone1: merged PR + e2e perf run (today). milestone2: production rollout gated behind cache API (Fri).

jamie: owner: cache API = jamie/eng-platform. milestone1: internal spec posted (tomorrow). milestone2: flag rollout to dev & staging (Thu).

sophia: owner: regressions & evals = sophia. milestone: confirm quality delta & produce per-route alert rules (Tue).

maria: rollout policy: require these checks before full promotion ->
- canary 10% for 24h with: latency P95 within +5ms, unit cost reduction >= 8%, quality regression <= 1%
- automatic rollback if quality regression > 2% or error rate > 0.5%

alex: config snippet for canary policy (for the checklist):
```yaml
rollout:
  type: canary
  percent: 10
  duration: 24h
  metrics:
    latency_p95: +5ms
    quality_delta: <=1%
    error_rate: <=0.5%
```

maria: perfect. please add the checklist items to the PR description and tag me.

kevin: will add validation artifacts + sample inputs (i.e., long_seq_faq.json) to the PR. also adding a note to revert to q4_0 per-route if quality drops.

sophia: I'll run targeted evals tonight and post results in this thread.

alex: once kevin's validation is green, I'll merge and schedule a canary.

maria: last ask — if any dependency delays (cache API or platform flags), call it out in #eng-platform immediately so we can push timeline. want one source of truth.

jamie: will do. ping @maria if scope slides.

maria: thanks everyone — short follow-ups: 1) kevin posts validation artifacts, 2) jamie posts spec, 3) alex merges after kevin signoff, 4) sophia posts regression numbers. aim to have canary started by Wed morning.

kevin: noted. starting validations now.

sophia: kicked off evals — will upload CSV and brief summary when done.

ci-bot: upload: test-artifacts/optkit/1812349999/ (artifacts available)

maria: closing the loop — I'll update the release checklist doc once we have the artifacts. if anything changes, reply in-thread. :thumbsup:
